data.body: Story C (06ae, config) TDD held-out loop complete. Epic 9109 re-reviewed -> PASS; epic + C claimed. Measured the tradeoff empirically with headless 'claude -p' runs (prompt-prefix = input+cache_read+cache_creation): 4 MCP servers deferral ON 36,961 vs OFF 100,813 (+63,852, +$0.40/fresh prefix); serena-only ON 33,786 vs OFF 59,240 (+25,454 = the floor, since the lever cannot select three tools). Chose ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH="false" with the numbers documented in docs/local-dev-env.md + a one-line revert. RED first: 8 tests authored, 5 failed for the right reasons (file absent / untracked / docs silent); the 3 gitignore-precision cases are survive-the-change invariants and were green before and after by design. Held out 5 edge tests; implementer (standard tier / sonnet, separate subagent) saw ONLY the happy path and reported green on attempt 1. Full held-out oracle then validated 8/8 GREEN. Teeth check passed on 3 mutations: value 'true' -> RED, JSON boolean false -> 2 RED, over-broad negation '!.claude/*' -> 3 RED; all restored. make lint + make typecheck clean; full make test running.
